mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_order (order_no, member_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, total_amount, paid_amount, points_used, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_address, status, paid_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{pointsUsed}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, #{status}, #{paidAt})

where.if: AND ( mall_order.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR mall_order.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR mall_order.recipient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR mall_order.recipient_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_order WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT mall_order.*, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(mall_product.images, '$[0]')) AS product_image FROM mall_order LEFT JOIN mall_product ON mall_product.id = mall_order.product_id WHERE mall_order.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mall_refund WHERE mall_order_id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_order SET status = 'SHIPPED', express_company = #{company}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_SHIPMENT'
UPDATE mall_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SHIPPED'
UPDATE mall_order SET status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_SHIPMENT'
